courses.look: the closest the bumpers get to the walls (15 cm to spare): who runs wide at the turn

courses.description: 5 m to a scoring pose; the true goal is 8 cm sideways and 3 deg off the map pose, revealed 1.5 m out
courses.look: time to settle on the TRUE goal after the tag moves it 8 cm and 3 deg, and the error left there

courses.description: drive through a game piece at 2 m/s; its detected position moves 10 cm sideways 2 m out
courses.look: how close each passes the piece after it moves 10 cm, and whether it is still going at 2 m/s

courses.description: three paths with rolling handoffs at 2 m/s (core-builder's neutral_three_piece, 2026 field)
courses.look: the whole auto's time with two rolling handoffs, and whether the hand-overs stay smooth

courses.description: an 8 m gentle curve with a 5 m/s cap (above the robot's 4.57 m/s free speed)
courses.look: who can use the top speed: time on a long gentle curve with the cap above what the robot can do

courses.description: the S-curve with a 68 kg robot (MOI 6.8) and a 192 A current limit (20 % lower)
courses.look: a heavier, weaker robot: who plans with the right robot and still settles cleanly
